instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Record one notification event for the audience the caller names, so it is kept and can be read back; nothing is delivered", and give it notification_id; kind; audience_refs; conversation_ref; privacy_class; title; body; occurred_at; source_refs; proof_refs.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:record-a-notification and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Pass the event: notification_id, kind, conversation_ref, privacy_class, title, body, occurred_at (words) and audience_refs, source_refs, proof_refs (each at least one reference).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: notification-event (records:read, records:write); notification-event-rules (records:read).
